register.labelZh: DUST 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: DUST 片語動詞可以描述拍走衣服、家具和其他物件上的粉末、沙或乾泥。；dust something off 或 down 可以表示重新採用舊計劃、舊食譜或舊節目。；dust yourself off 或 down 可以描述某人在失望或失敗後重新振作,繼續嘗試。；同一個 DUST 表達既可以描述實際清潔,也可以用來談論重新採用舊計劃或從挫折中振作。
register.summaryEn: DUST expressions can describe removing powder, sand or dry dirt from clothes, furniture and other objects. Dust something off or down allows you to explain that an old plan, recipe or programme is being used again. Dust yourself off or down describes someone recovering from disappointment and continuing to try. The same DUST expression may describe cleaning something physically or dealing with an old plan or a disappointment.
